entities.summary: John William Peers is an Australian professional tennis player who specialises in doubles. He has been ranked by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) as high as world No. 2 in doubles, which he achieved on 3 April 2017, and No. 456 in singles, attained on 11 June 2012. He has won 30 doubles titles on the ATP Tour.
